CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers.
   B. Use Healing the 10 Lepers to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)

   B. Skipping all moral lessons
